sar.narrative: This report details suspected coordinated fraud involving customer C13487 and card C13487-K1. On 2016-11-22 at 16:11:00, an online transaction of $74.96 was attempted using the device profile SM-G935F Build/NRD90M | Android 7.0 | chrome 62.0 for android | 1920x1080. This device was marked as New for the account and the session was routed through an anonymous proxy. An earlier online transaction of $112.37 occurred on 2016-11-15, bringing the total exposure to $187.33. The activity is highly suspicious because the card is historically used almost exclusively in person, with only 2 of 71 prior transactions being online. Furthermore, graph analysis shows this specific, fully specified device profile was used on 19 other cards belonging to 19 other customers between 2016-11-14 and 2016-11-22, frequently behind an anonymizing proxy. The transaction model scored the event at 0.064. Due to the coordinated nature of this abuse across multiple accounts, a suspicious activity report is being filed.
